name: Colorful Roses
overview: A father lives a harsh life with his children, and the author sheds light on some misconceptions in our society through the character of "Abdul Wahab," portrayed by the artist Ibrahim Al-Harbi. The story begins with a son born to a Syrian woman who gives birth to four daughters, then returns to his first mother, "Khalida" (played by Salma Salem), who gives birth to his only son. [2] The series was scheduled to air in Ramadan 2020 but was postponed due to the outbreak of the Coronavirus. Its completion is yet to be announced.
